MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The wired earbuds give me a compact option for laptop listening and calls, which fits my headphone purchases while serving a different use from my larger headsets.",
    "The 4K Fire TV Stick feels like a useful addition to my home electronics setup because it offers convenient TV streaming alongside the HDMI equipment I already have."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another HDMI cable or similar 32GB memory card repeats something I already own without addressing a new need.",
    "The Echo devices assume I want voice control or a dedicated smart display, but my purchases have focused on practical computer accessories.",
    "The tablet does not fill a current need alongside my Kindle, and the Wi-Fi extender does not follow from my recent effort to add wired networking.",
    "The other Fire TV Sticks are less appealing because I would choose the 4K version instead of buying multiple streaming devices."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning electronics seems to be treated as a reason to want a broad range of popular electronic devices, even when their uses differ from my current needs.",
    "My purchases of cables, storage and Amazon devices seem to lead to more of the same, even when I have already covered those needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases point toward organizing, maintaining and connecting a computer setup, including a headphone mount, duster and wired networking accessories.",
    "A related item is more useful when it adds a distinct purpose, like portable earbuds alongside larger headphones, than when it duplicates a cable or memory card.",
    "My frequent purchases do not mean I need replacements or additional devices for every function I already have covered."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in electronics but often miss the specific practical need that would make another device or accessory useful now."
}
